Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> National Telecel rewards customer with brand new Hyundai Creta in Dream Car Promo Source : Telecel Ghana 2 November 2026 5:13pm Audio By Carbonatix
Telecel Ghana presented a brand-new Hyundai Creta to the grand prize winner of the 15th cycle of its Dream Car Promo, reaffirming its commitment to transforming customers' lives through rewarding, impactful experiences.
The presentation, held at the Dome Market in Accra, marked the delivery of the eighth vehicle awarded under the popular Dream Car Promo, which has transformed the lives of subscribers across the country over the years.
The latest winner, Eric Ayamga, a security and intelligence officer and Telecel customer for more than 15 years, received the keys to his new vehicle alongside three family members.
For Mr Ayamga, the win is the culmination of a journey that began when he first joined the promotion last year and expressed his appreciation to the telecommunications company for fulfilling its promise.
"I was motivated to take this Dream Car promo more seriously after I watched videos of the previous winner receiving his car," he said. "The Dream Car Promo is real and genuine.
"As I have won today, it is a testimony, and I want to encourage everyone to also try, and they could be winning like me. I'm so excited, I can't measure it in words. Thank you very much, Telecel. I'm so grateful," he added.
Speaking at the presentation ceremony, Carlos Asare-Okoh, Senior Manager, Mobile Data and Digital Services of Telecel Ghana, said the promotion reflects Telecel Ghana's commitment to helping customers achieve their aspirations.
"As a brand, we aim to support our customers to be able to achieve their dreams and goals in life," he said. "Our promotions are intentional to impact and change the lives of our customers."
With the 16 th cycle of the promo already underway, Mr Asare-Okoh announced a GH¢100,000 cash prize to be awarded in December, alongside the existing monthly cash rewards, giving customers even more chances to win.
"We encourage customers to keep playing and increase their chances of winning," he added.
The Dream Car Promo is a six-month, SMS-based trivia competition that allows customers to participate by dialling *2018#. Subscribers receive four trivia questions daily, earning 100 points for every correct answer and 25 points for each incorrect answer. The participant with the highest accumulated score at the end of the campaign wins the grand prize vehicle.
The promo runs in partnership with Vasmol and is regulated by the National Lottery Authority (NLA) on the Caritas Lottery platform to ensure transparency, fairness, and credibility throughout the campaign.
